descriptions.preferred: 帝王 一号树体强健，是一个非常优秀的品种，由美国宾夕法尼亚州红枫苗圃的Richard P Wolff在 1976 年发现 ， 后来由美国俄勒冈的某位苗圃主命名并商业化推广。 它的新叶萌发时间比 "血红"晚两周，因此得以避免早春的霜冻、低温以及寒风。 它在遮阴条件下也能保持优良的叶色，因此其适应性更强。 整个生长季 帝王 一号的叶色均为深紫红色，秋季则变为美丽的深红色。 与 "血红"相比，其叶片结构 比 "血红"纤薄，因此在阳光下呈现出半透明的质感，并泛着红光。 叶片较大，具 有 5-7裂，且叶裂深。 叶缘锯齿细密，叶柄短于叶片，呈暗红色。 帝王 一号抗性强，树形直立，冠幅宽广，可以作为大型景观的主树。

rhs.description: A large bushy deciduous shrub or small tree to 5m tall with 5-7-lobed, deep red-purple leaves, turning crimson in autumn. The leaves appear later than many other cultivars, reducing the risk of damage by spring frost

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Flower borders and beds, Cottage/Informal Garden, Low Maintenance, Architectural, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , pruning if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting , softwood cuttings or layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 大型、开展的落叶灌木或小乔木，高可达 5 米；叶 5-7 裂，深红紫色，秋季转为猩红色。 其叶片萌发时间较许多其他品种稍晚，可降低遭受春霜危害的风险。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有必要，仅在深秋至仲冬期间修剪
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接、嫩枝扦插或压条繁殖

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Emperor 1' Japanese Maple Tree
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Emperor 1' Red Emperor Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Emperor 1’ is one of our favorite red upright Japanese maples. Also known as 'Red Emperor', the early spring color of this Japanese maple comes out as an extremely deep maroon with a brilliant translucent sheen that gives the leaves a nice shiny look as the sunlight hits them. This 'Emperor 1' Japanese maple holds its rich, dark red foliage well throughout the summer months, and has a brilliant scarlet fall display. The underside of the leaf is a rich olive green. The 'Emperor 1' Japanese maple makes a beautiful dynamic to the shiny red tops as the leaves turn blowing in a light summer breeze. ‘Emperor 1’ is a vigorous growing red Japanese maple though it stays midsized overall at around 15 feet in height. Hardiness is another great quality of ‘Emperor 1’. This Red Emperor Japanese maple tree handles cold conditions extremely well and is also very heat tolerant in the late summer. With all of its wonderful attributes ‘Emperor 1’ makes a perfect choice for a mid-sized upright red Japanese maple.
